chunks: Peace be upon him: O God, I ask You by the right of Muhammad and the family of Muhammad, that You send blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad.
And by the right of the Imams from among them, that You make me among those who deserve their intercession on the Day of Resurrection.
ai.seo_question: What is the supplication for seeking the intercession of the Imams?
ai.summary: This supplication, found in Shaykh al-Saduq’s *Kamal al-Din*, emphasizes the Shia doctrine of *al-wilayah* and the intercessory role of the Ahl al-Bayt, reflecting the theological emphasis on their spiritual authority as the sole mediators between God and humanity. It underscores the belief that true salvation is contingent upon recognizing and adhering to the rights (*haqq*) of the Prophet and the Twelve Imams, a core tenet in Shia eschatology.
